shared_elements: low-relief carved figural scene on a wall surface
figures carrying or holding objects in raised hands
registers or bands organizing the composition
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures in long fringed robes with an arm raised holding an object, rendered with the same flat, linear, outline-and-incised-detail conventions and stylized vegetal filler motifs, which is a fairly specific shared manner. But A is a multi-register procession of many small repeated figures leading animals, while B is a single monumental bird-headed winged figure beside a stylized tree, so the compositional scheme and the key subject (composite winged creature vs. human tribute bearers) differ substantially.
